title: Lesson 124: Isaiah 53—Jesus Christ Has “Borne Our Griefs, and Carried Our Sorrows”

footnotes.text: Beauty could mean that there was nothing about the Savior’s physical appearance that would draw people to Him.
This could refer to people who didn’t believe in the Savior or His mission (seeMatthew 27:22–23;Luke 4:16–30; andJohn 1:11).
Griefs can refer to our pains, afflictions, sicknesses, and weaknesses that Jesus Christ took upon Himself (seeAlma 7:11–12).
“Chastisement of our peace” could refer to the penalty Jesus Christ suffered for our sins.
Stripes can refer to the wounds left on the Savior’s body when He was scourged (seeMatthew 27:26).
Jesus was crucified along with two thieves (seeLuke 23:32– 33).
This could mean that Heavenly Father was pleased that Jesus willingly offered Himself as a sacrifice for our sins.
This refers to those who believe the testimony of the prophets concerning Jesus Christ (seeMosiah 15:10–13).
Succorcan describe how the Savior cares for us.
